answer: A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the atlas of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. What survives to the mirror is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
